Des Plaines Upgrades 911 Services with Unified Dispatch Published on October 27, 2026 Effective today (October 27, 2026), the Des Plaines Fire Department begins receiving fire and emergency medical dispatch services from the Cook County Sheriff’s Police 911 Center. The center already provides dispatch services for the Des Plaines Police Department. The change puts the City’s police, fire, and emergency medical dispatch services under one provider.
